The ultrasound shows a thickened endometrial stripe and a left adnexal mass, which raises concern for malignancy. Given the postmenopausal bleeding, I need to rule out endometrial cancer, so I will request an endometrial biopsy. I also need to clarify if you have had a hysterectomy in the past, as that changes the clinical picture significantly.

speaker: Doctor

The biopsy confirms well-differentiated endometrial adenocarcinoma, which is the primary cause of your bleeding. The adnexal mass likely represents metastatic spread, so I will request a CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis to stage the disease accurately.
